A goods train accelerates uniformly from rest to a speed of 30 m/s in 20 seconds.
It travels at 30 m/s for t seconds and then slows down uniformly to rest in a further 40 seconds.

Find the value of t.

Calculate the average speed of the train for the whole journey.
Give your answer correct to 3 significant figures.
